page.overview:
Who is Aniko Seremai?

Sir was a knight of House Seremai. As an NPC, he was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Aniko was a powerful knight of impressive appearance: 6'9" in height, broad-shouldered, with a forked tongue and snake-like eyes; his features became even more reptilian when he used his powers, which produced a poisonous green glow. He was skilled with spear, longsword, and shield, and carried those with him, the latter displaying the coat of arms of his family.

He had a dark and sadistic personality, mocking people for the losses he had caused, and being fascinated with the idea of facing his enemies again in the Underworld. However, Aniko preferred murder to combat.

Aniko was born as a member of the Vassal House of Seremai, and as such, he was at the service of House Tachonis. As other members of his lineage he eventually manifested sorcerous powers, and in time, also became a knight. He had experience with basilisks and worked in Obrimus Manor for a time (later focusing on working specifically with Segundus Tachonis's children), where he learned things about them, including a "trick" that he eventually shared with his liege lords.
